subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Shipped off.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate option to fill in** blank number 4 **is** "shipped off."**
 
• This is because the phrase** "shipped off"** means **to send something away, usually by a means of transportation such as a ship or plane**.
 
• In the context of the sentence, it makes sense to say that the products were shipped off to various locations, as this would indicate that they were sent out for distribution or sale. 
 
• The other options do not make as much sense in the context of the sentence.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 2.**

Correct Paragraph__: *Many fruits and vegetables change (1) __colour__ as they ripen. For example, tomatoes, strawberries, and red bell peppers all change from green to red. Colour is just one way along with size, texture, and smell that you can tell if a fruit or vegetable is (2) __ready__ to be harvested or eaten. Imagine a factory that (3) __packs__ strawberries into plastic containers to be **(4)** **__**shipped off**__* *to grocery stores across the country. It might be useful to have a machine that automatically (5) ______ any green strawberries that were picked before they were ripe. Or, you might want a machine on the farm that automatically recognizes strawberries by colour and only picks the red ones to begin with.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Managed of"** is not a proper phrase in English and does not convey any meaning.
 
• **"Suited to" **means that something is appropriate or well-matched for a particular purpose, but this does not fit with the idea of products being sent out for distribution.
 
• **"Accounted to"** means to explain or justify something, but this does not fit with the context of the sentence either.
